notes.title: GO (BACK) TO HELL
notes.content:
BOSS RUSH:

There is a new boss rush area you can find in the hub world, you must beat all bosses to open it.
Face all bosses back to back to get 3 shards.


REDONE BOSSFIGHTS:

Gluttony's boss fight has been completely reworked
All 3 major boss fights have been given balance tweaks along with new music


WRATH EXPANSION:

New areas have been added to CIRCLE 05: WRATH


VIOLENCE RECOLOR:

CIRCLE 07: VIOLENCE has been recolored and retextured


SECRET SNOWGLOBE:

Can you find the secret snow globe in the hub world? It will take you to a new secret area with 2 bonus shards.

notes.title: Goop Patch
notes.content:
I have added new tutorial markers in the intro section.

I have changed ziplines and mirrors to use a keypress to activate instead of auto-activating.

After receiving feedback, I've modified the goop so that it all destroys from a single shot. This should also lead to a slight boost in loading times.

notes.title: Dialogue Volume Patch
notes.content:
I have patched the game so all dialogue volume is at a similar volume. If anyone runs into any other issues please do not hesitate to let me know in the Steam Community page. 

Thank you,
Jackson Clayton
